title: 第3章  玩点刺激的第4章  她是侄子的女朋友
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
谢烬沉有着一头紫色的头发，跟它的狐狸尾巴一个颜色。
他那双紫瞳魅惑十足，在帝王星是很有名的纨绔子弟，经常和各种女星，嫩模出现在娱乐新闻上。
季欢淡声说：“没带女朋友来？”
平时他参加这种聚会，都会带着女朋友来的，虽然每次都不是同一个。
谢烬沉笑了，“姐姐，我已经空窗半个月了。”
季欢踩着高跟鞋往别墅走，谢烬沉跟在她的身后。
谢烬沉的目光微深，今天的季欢很不一样，紫色的抹胸礼服。
这是属于他的颜色，总给他一种暗示，好像姐姐对他有意思。
三人进到别墅，里面已经有不少宾客了。
三三两两聚在一起喝酒，聊天，还有一些在泳池里玩水。
程永夜跟在一个漂亮的女孩身边，她穿着白色的短款礼服，清清纯纯的。
程永夜在看到进门的三人，他笑着朝他们走来，那个穿着白裙子的女孩也跟着过来。
程永夜介绍道：“雾眠，这三位是我的好兄弟，她叫季欢，这是裴西川，他是谢烬沉。”
季欢没想到他是这么介绍自己的，好兄弟，果然，他没把她当女人看。
程永夜又说：“她叫白雾眠，兔族的，今天就是她的生日。”
白雾眠笑着打招呼。
“你们好！”
裴西川：“生日快乐！”
谢烬沉痞痞一笑，“早知道是位美女过生日，我就带礼物来了。”
白雾眠笑着说：“谢谢你们！你们能来参加我已经很开心了，不需要礼物的。”

这时有人找白雾眠，她说过去一下，程永夜对她宠溺一笑。
“去吧！”
程永夜一把搂住季欢和谢烬沉，他小声说着。
“我想追她，你们觉得怎么样？长得是不是很好看？”
谢烬沉淡声说：“挺纯的，就是身材差点。”
他说这话的时候，看向季欢，她的身材好，曲线简直完美。
裴西川没在听他们聊天，目光跟随着蓝月璃，接着他丢下他们，就朝蓝月璃走去。
季欢看到裴西川去找他的女神了，心底莫名有点不舒服。
这本书里的这些男人，就没一个好东西。
所以，她就算玩弄他们，也是他们活该。
程永夜笑着说：“我就喜欢清纯这一挂的。”
content_en:
Xie Jinchen has purple hair, the same color as his fox tail.
His purple eyes are full of charm, and he is a well-known playboy in the Emperor Planet. He often appears in entertainment news with various actresses and young models.
Ji Huan said quietly: "Didn't you bring your girlfriend?"
Usually when he attends such gatherings, he brings his girlfriend, although it's not the same one every time.
Xie Jin smiled deeply, "Sister, I've been vacant for half a month."
Ji Huan walked to the villa in high heels, with Xie Jinchen following behind her.
Xie Jinchen's eyes deepened slightly, Ji Huan was very different today, wearing a purple tube top dress.
This is his color, and it always gives him a hint that his sister is interested in him.
The three of them entered the villa, where there were already many guests.
Twos and threes gathered together to drink and chat, and some played in the swimming pool.
Cheng Yongye followed a beautiful girl. She was wearing a short white dress, pure and pure.
When Cheng Yongye saw the three people entering the door, he smiled and walked towards them. The girl in the white skirt also followed.
Cheng Yongye introduced: "Wu Mian, these three are my good brothers. Her name is Ji Huan, this is Pei Xichuan, and he is Xie Jinchen."
Ji Huan didn't expect him to introduce himself like this, good brother. Sure enough, he didn't regard her as a woman.
Cheng Yongye added: "Her name is Bai Wumian, from the rabbit tribe, and today is her birthday."
Bai Wumian smiled and greeted.
"Hello!"
Pei Xichuan: "Happy birthday!"
Xie Jinchen smiled mischievously, "If I had known it was a beautiful woman's birthday, I would have brought a gift."
Bai Wumian smiled and said, "Thank you! I'm very happy that you can come to participate. No gifts are needed."
At this time, someone came to Bai Wumian. She asked to come over, and Cheng Yongye gave her a doting smile.
"Go!"
Cheng Yongye hugged Ji Huan and Xie Jinchen and whispered.
"I want to chase her, what do you think? Does she look good?"
Xie Jin said quietly: "She's quite pure, but her figure is a little off."
When he said this, he looked at Ji Huan. She had a good figure and her curves were perfect.
Pei Xichuan was not listening to their chat, and followed Lan Yueli with his eyes. Then he left them and walked towards Lan Yueli.
Ji Huan felt a little uncomfortable for no reason when he saw Pei Xichuan going to find his goddess.
None of the men in this book are good.
Therefore, even if she plays tricks on them, they deserve it.
Cheng Yongye smiled and said, "I just like the purity aspect."
